a16z-hyperexponential:ashbyhq:efdb0196-5.description: Hi, I’m Amrit - CEO and Co-founder at hyperexponential. hx started with a belief that a small group of talented, curious people could take on one of the most complex parts of insurance and build something meaningfully better. That belief has always shaped the kind of company we are trying to build. Some of the people who have had the biggest impact at hx joined early in their careers, learned quickly, took ownership, and grew as the company grew. We want to make more of those journeys possible. That is why we are hiring our next group of graduates into our technical teams. As hx scales, we need to keep bringing in people who are technically strong, curious, and excited by hard problems. The work we do is not simple. We help commercial insurers make faster, smarter decisions across underwriting, pricing and portfolio management. That means working at the intersection of technology, data, actuarial thinking, AI and real-world customer problems. This is not a traditional graduate scheme where you spend months on the sidelines. You will join teams building important parts of our platform, learn from experienced engineers and technical leaders, and build the context you need to contribute properly. For me, this is about building the next generation of hx - not as a side project, but as part of how we scale. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. You’ll be embedded in a technical team, while also getting structured exposure to other parts of hx through time spent alongside our Customer teams and shadowing Central Functions. Across the programme, you’ll build technical confidence, product understanding and commercial awareness. You’ll also complete our Model Development certification, giving you a stronger understanding of the insurance, modelling and pricing context behind what we build.
